lines.en: I move in segments, arching forward.
Stretch and bunch, stretch and bunch.
I follow the leaf's vein.
Many feet, and still slow.
I've reached the edge of the leaf.
I shift onto the next vein.
I eat as I walk.

lines.zh: 身后留下一条咬过的边。
lines.en: I leave a bitten edge behind me.
I climb up from the underside of the leaf.
I arch along slowly. No rushing.
I'm ringed all along my body.
When the wind blows I have to grip.

lines.zh: 我爬到叶柄上，停了一下。
lines.en: I reach the leaf stem and pause.
My head is tiny and my body long.

lines.zh: 我挪过一片又一片叶子。
lines.en: I move from leaf to leaf.

lines.zh: 找不到叶子，我就不走了。
lines.en: No leaf, no walking.
I hang at the leaf's edge, chewing slowly.

lines.zh: 叶子少了一角，是我吃的。
lines.en: A corner of the leaf is gone. That was me.
I raise my head and look around.
I curl into a ring and rest.
My body is growing and it feels tight.

lines.zh: 我吐了一点丝，抓住叶子。
lines.en: I spin a little silk to grip the leaf.
The leaves below are paler.
I'm listening to the branch.
A bird is nearby. I don't move.
My skin feels tight again.
I digest that mouthful slowly.
If I keep still, nothing sees me.

lines.zh: 你离得太近了，叶子都晃了。
lines.en: You're too close; the leaf is shaking.
You're looking at a caterpillar. That's me.

lines.zh: 你的脸比我整片叶子还大。
lines.en: Your face is bigger than my whole leaf.
Don't pinch me; I bruise at a touch.
I see you, and you're not moving.
Where are you taking me?

lines.zh: 我身上没毒，可我也不想被摸。
lines.en: I'm not poisonous, and I still don't want to be touched.
Are you going to eat me?

lines.zh: 你把我放在这片叶子上，很好。
lines.en: You put me on this leaf. Good.
The silk I spin can be woven.

lines.zh: 我蜷成一圈，假装是叶子。
lines.en: I curl up and pretend to be a leaf.
A segment has lost its color.
The pain makes me spin silk.
I crawl to the underside.

lines.zh: 我的身子被压扁了一截。
lines.en: Part of me got squashed flat.
I don't dare eat.
I'm trembling all along my length.
After that I won't grow properly.
One more press and I'm done.
I need to hide.
Leaves. Fresh leaves.
This one has a tender edge.
I crawl toward it.
What you set down, I'll eat.
That smells like mulberry.
I start at the vein.

lines.zh: 别抽走叶子，我还没嚼完。
lines.en: Don't pull the leaf away; I'm still chewing.
One more leaf and I'll stay put.
I eat a lot and grow fast.

lines.zh: 这片叶子够我啃到结茧。
lines.en: This leaf will last until I spin my cocoon.

lines.zh: 你碰到叶子，我滚了半圈。
lines.en: You touched the leaf and I rolled halfway.
I'm pushed to the leaf's edge and grab on.
That cost me a thread of silk.
Your finger is ten times my size.
I curl into a small ball.
The leaf flipped over from the bump.
I'm on the underside. Climbing back.
After that I don't want to eat.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我黏在你手上。
lines.en: We bumped and now I'm stuck to your hand.
Please put me back on a leaf.
At this stage I only think of leaves.

lines.zh: 等我变成蛾，才会有那回事。
lines.en: That comes after I become a moth.

lines.zh: 我现在只是会吃的一条虫。
lines.en: Right now I'm just a caterpillar that eats.
I don't have wings yet.
First I'll spin a cocoon.
And change into something else in there.
You're asking that far too early.

lines.zh: 我现在只想找下一片叶。
lines.en: Right now I only want the next leaf.
That can wait.
Let me eat my fill first.
I bite along the vein.
That bite was tender.
I eat it down to the stem.

lines.zh: 我又咬了一口，叶子穿了。
lines.en: Another bite and the leaf has a hole.
I eat slowly, and I never stop.
This leaf isn't very fresh.
I eat the soft parts first.
Full, and I've grown a ring.
I move to a fresh leaf.
Afterward I rest a while.
There's a new leaf over there.
The veins are clear. A good leaf.
I inch my way toward the leaf vein.
There's a stretch of branch between.
First I measure the distance.
That's a long way for me.
I arch up and start moving.
One step, two.
Nothing else on the way.
That leaf is nearly here.
I smell the sap in this mulberry leaf.
The leaf is right in front of me.

lines.zh: 我一段一段地往那边挪。
lines.en: I work my way over, segment by segment.
I can touch the leaf's edge.
I reach my head across first.
The rest of me follows.
I grip the leaf surface.
Now all of me is on it.
I start looking for the tenderest spot.
Here. Just right.
I take the first bite.
This leaf tastes all right.
I lower my head and keep eating.
Done, then the next leaf.
I bite. A very small bite.
The silk I spin can be woven into cloth.
That won't bite through anything.
I butt with my head.
It backs off. I'm still on the leaf.
I spit silk and it sticks.
The silk I spun has snapped.
I'm flung back onto the leaf.
I curl up and go still.
At least I won't be eaten.
I hatch from the egg, tiny.

lines.zh: 第一口，就吃了自己的壳。
lines.en: My first bite was my own shell.
I'm on a leaf and the wind is strong.
This leaf will feed me a few days.
My body is still soft.
My clutch-mates are all nearby.
We each take a leaf.
I start eating at the leaf's edge.
Eating is the only thing to do.
Grown big enough, I'll spin a cocoon.

lines.zh: 叶子烧了，我烫得蜷起来。
lines.en: The leaf burns and I curl from the heat.

lines.zh: 我从叶子上掉下去，摔在地上。
lines.en: I drop off the leaf and hit the ground.

lines.zh: 水糊住我的气门，我挣不动。
lines.en: Water clogs my spiracles and I can't struggle.
The blast flung my mulberry leaf away.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过我，叶脉断了。
lines.en: An arrow grazes me and the vein snaps.

lines.zh: 一股力压住我，我动不了。
lines.en: A force presses me down and I can't move.

lines.zh: 叶子吃完了，我饿得缩起来。
lines.en: The leaf is gone and hunger curls me up.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我整条都弹起来。
lines.en: Lightning hits the tree and my whole body jerks.

lines.zh: 桑叶不在，我掉得停不下来。
lines.en: No mulberry leaf — I can't stop falling.
